about_the_game:
Offline Only / Solo Play

No internet connection required—enjoy the full experience on your own.

4-on-4 Team Battles

All teammates and enemies are AI-controlled. Teamwork and situational awareness are the keys to victory.

Simple Controls × Fast-Paced Action

No complicated inputs required. Enjoy speedy robot battles with intuitive controls.

Stage-Clear Progression

Each stage introduces powerful bosses. Clear a stage to earn points, then use those points to unlock new weapons. Gaining stronger equipment expands your tactical options.

Challenging Replayability

Despite simple rules, battles are intense and difficult. Repeated attempts are often required, but the sense of achievement when you finally succeed is immense.

Gameplay

Your mission is to pilot your robot and defeat the enemy team.

Experience fast-paced combat action and simple yet powerful battles.

Story

“Humanity was defeated by AI technology. Yet, it did not perish.

The bipedal weapons created by AI were captured and modified for human use. Reprogrammed AI units were added as allies, and the fight began anew.

You are humanity’s last pilot. With three AI partners at your side, launch into battle.”

short_description: Steel Mech Battle is a 3D robot action game designed exclusively for solo and offline play. Team up with AI allies and take on 4-on-4 battles as you progress through each stage. Defeat enemies to earn points and unlock stronger weapons, experiencing stage-clear style action with every victory.
